name: What is the difference between a partial and a full bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a partial and a full bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A partial bathroom remodel focuses on cosmetic updates without altering the room's layout or major structural elements. This might include repainting, replacing fixtures, or updating the vanity. A full bathroom remodel, on the other hand, involves a complete overhaul, often including demolition, changing the layout, relocating plumbing and electrical, and replacing all major components. Full remodels are more extensive, costly, and take longer but offer a completely new look and feel.
acceptedAnswer.description: A partial remodel updates cosmetics without layout changes, while a full remodel involves a complete overhaul, including demolition and layout changes.
